question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NVIDIA's recent quarters (Q4 FY26-Q2 FY27) where actuals beat guide midpoint by 4.6-5.7% and the next guide was 1.115-1.145x the just-reported actual. Q3 guide $108B -> expected actual ~$113B (111-116) -> Q4 guide ~$127B. Sell-side Q4 consensus ~$124.5B (MarketBeat/Yahoo, 42 analysts); NVIDIA typically guides above consensus. Upside: 70% FY28 growth commentary and $279B supply commitments. Downside: memory constraints, no China DC compute in guidance. Markets: no matching human market; Polymarket Q3 Data Center contracts (>105B at 0.51, thin volume <$1k) are near-misses for Q3 DC revenue, not Q4 guidance, but imply Q3 total ~ $113B, consistent with the beat pattern.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 (qtr ended Jul 26, 2026): revenue $96.2B (+18% QoQ, +106% YoY), DC $89.0B; GM 75.0% (NVIDIA PR / CNBC, Aug 26 2026).
- Q3 FY27 guide: $108.0B +/-2%, no China DC compute assumed; GM 74.0% +/-50bp (NVIDIA PR Aug 26 2026).
- Q2 FY27 guide was $91.0B; actual 96.2 (+5.7% vs midpoint). Q1 FY27 actual $81.6B vs guide ~$78B (+~4.6%). Q4 FY26 actual ~$68.1B vs guide $65B (+~4.8%) (SEC 8-Ks, CNBC).
- Next-guide/prior-actual ratios: Q1FY27 guide/Q4FY26 actual ~1.145; Q2 guide/Q1 actual 91/81.6=1.115; Q3 guide/Q2 actual 108/96.2=1.123. Absolute step guide minus prior actual: +9.4B, +11.8B.
- Sell-side consensus Q4 FY27 revenue ~ $124.5B (42 analysts, MarketBeat/Yahoo, ~Nov 2026); implies ~83% YoY. Q3 FY27 consensus ~ $108.8B (whisper EPS 2.60 vs 2.49 consensus, EarningsWhispers).
- CFO projected 70% FY28 revenue growth (vs Street 44%) in Aug 2026; supply commitments rose to $279B from $119B, mostly memory (CNBC Aug 26 2026).
- Headwinds: memory scarcity/pricing; GM expected to bottom ~71-72% in Q4 FY27; China DC compute excluded from guidance.
- Status quo: NVIDIA has issued a single-midpoint +/-2% revenue guide every quarter; continuation expected.
- Resolves off midpoint of Q4 FY27 revenue outlook in Q3 FY27 press release (Nov 17, 2026), rounded to nearest $B; not off actual Q3 revenue or consensus.
- Event window: single release Nov 17, 2026; as of Nov 2, 2026 the release has not occurred.
- Searched but not found: direct analyst estimates of Q4 guide specifically (vs Q4 consensus revenue), any mid-quarter guidance update.

calls.reasoning: Over the last 3 quarters NVIDIA came in 5-6% above its own guidance (Q1 $82B vs $78B guide; Q2 $96.2B vs $91B), then guided the next quarter 11-14.5% (+$9-12B) above the prior actual. Applying that to the $108B Q3 guide gives a Q3 actual of about $112-114.5B, and Polymarket's Q3 Data Center markets (~even odds above $105B) are consistent with that. The resulting Q4 guide is about $124-131B, centered near $127B. Consensus is ~$124.5B, and NVIDIA's guides have topped consensus by 3-7%. Risks: memory supply limits, gross margin compression, and China excluded from guidance; upside comes from the 70% FY28 growth outlook. Polymarket only has thin Q3 Data Center contracts, a different quantity, so they count as evidence, not an anchor; no market on the Q4 guide was found.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share facts and method (beat-then-step pattern plus guide-over-consensus) and land at medians of 127.0-127.2. The factual differences (Q1 actual 81.6 vs 82; step quoted in dollars vs percent) are rounding and don't matter. The consensus-premium method points slightly above the cadence method (128-130 vs 126-127), so I set the median a touch above the runs at 127.3. Tail widths are a judgment call; I took about 4% escape mass on each side, between Run 1 and Run 3. No web access on this run.
